kpis.name: Registry entries at latest version
kpis.how: one exact GET /v0.1/servers/<name>/versions/latest per manifest name, compared with the release version. NOT a substring search: with 30,395 servers in the registry a search can push the exact match off page one, which is how this read 41 of 91 while a direct sample of 12 returned 12 of 12 present
kpis.why: The official registry is the index Claude, Cursor and VS Code pickers read.

kpis.name: Registry findable share
kpis.how: data/organic.json (name-substring search probes)
kpis.why: Search is name-only; a server nobody can find by the words they type does not exist.

kpis.name: Distribution surfaces live
kpis.how: data/distribution.json
kpis.why: Each free registry or catalog is a compounding source of installs.

kpis.name: URLs offered in the sitemap
kpis.how: curl mcp.zovo.one/sitemap.xml
kpis.why: Not a score to maximise. It was 312, of which 216 were client-by-product setup permutations measuring 73.6-77.5% similar to each other; Googlebot read the sitemap 7 times and then crawled 2 pages. Cut to 96 on 2026-09-07 and the permutations marked noindex,follow. See docs/SEO_INDEXATION_R1.md.

kpis.name: Google impressions, storefront
kpis.how: GSC host-filtered date query, HTTP/API errors checked; control zovo.one: 5486 impressions/49 clicks
kpis.why: Zero here across 99+ days means Google has never shown this site to anyone. It is the single most important organic number.

kpis.name: Repo clone-to-view ratio
kpis.how: data/baselines/loop33_baseline.json, gh api traffic/clones vs traffic/views. Baseline 2026-09-10: 3,410 clones from 502 unique clients against 54 views from 31 humans.
kpis.why: Not a score to maximise. It states who the repo front door is actually serving, which is machines by about 63 to 1, and it is why the repo is written for a reader that is mostly not a person.

kpis.name: Googlebot URL coverage
kpis.how: data/traffic.json crawler_url_coverage, Cloudflare GraphQL by user agent
kpis.why: Googlebot fetched robots.txt 4x and sitemap.xml 7x in the same window and then crawled 2 pages. It is declining, not blocked.

kpis.name: ClaudeBot URL coverage
kpis.how: data/traffic.json crawler_url_coverage
kpis.why: Assistant crawlers have this catalogue even though Google does not. This is the discovery channel that is actually working.

kpis.name: Render-qualified browser requests (assets included)
kpis.how: Cloudflare UA + rendering-resource heuristic; includes automation/operator; not people or page views

kpis.name: GitHub unique visitors
kpis.how: gh api repos/theluckystrike/mcp-servers/traffic/{views,clones,popular/referrers,popular/paths}; not independently verified humans
kpis.why: The repo is the other front door. 0 stars, 0 forks and 0 watchers since 2026-09-02.

kpis.name: Release asset fetches (mostly automated)
kpis.how: gh api releases (scripts/measure.mjs). NOT an install count: across 597 assets the counts are near-uniform (mean 8.90, median 8, p10 6, p90 11, top 10 of 597 hold 5.7%), and obsolete releases score the same per asset as the current one. Human demand is a power law; this is machine sweeping. See docs/AUDIENCE_REALITY_R1.md.
kpis.why: Kept for continuity only. It was previously reported as an install metric against a target of 1,000 and read as met, which was wrong.

kpis.why: npx is the default install path in every client guide; blocked on npm login.

kpis.why: A plausible wrong answer costs more than an error.

kpis.name: Click to checkout-session ratio
